title: Product shots
summary: Tabletop, hero spin, unboxing, in-use, liquid splash and packshot prompts for any product you sell.
examples: a soy candle in an amber jar
a bag of fresh-roasted coffee beans

templates.title: Tabletop push in
templates.use: The opening shot of a product ad.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: sits on a wooden tabletop as a soft beam of light slides across it

audio.sfx: a soft click as light lands

templates.title: Hero spin
templates.use: Show every side on a clean background.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: turns slowly and evenly through a full rotation
templates.light: soft studio light with a crisp edge highlight

templates.title: Orbit on a plinth
templates.use: A premium look for a launch.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: stands still on a stone plinth
templates.light: rim light and a soft top light

templates.title: Unboxing from above
templates.use: The first look at a delivery.
templates.subject: a pair of hands
templates.action: lifts the lid of a box and takes out {product}

audio.sfx: tissue paper rustles, the lid slides off

templates.title: Unboxing point of view
templates.use: Feels like the viewer is opening it.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: is lifted out of its box toward the camera

templates.title: In use, hands only
templates.use: Show what it does without a face.
templates.subject: a pair of hands
templates.action: uses {product} the way it is meant to be used, step by step

templates.title: In use, real moment
templates.use: Your product in everyday life.
templates.subject: {person}
templates.action: reaches for {product} and uses it with a relaxed smile

templates.title: Liquid splash
templates.use: Drinks, skincare, cleaning products.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: drops into clear water and sends up a crown of droplets
templates.light: crisp backlight making every droplet sparkle

templates.title: Slow pour
templates.use: Sauces, coffee, oils, candles.
templates.subject: a slow stream of liquid
templates.action: pours over {product} and catches the light

templates.title: Final packshot
templates.use: The last frame with room for your logo.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: sits centered with clear space above it

templates.title: Texture close-up
templates.use: Prove the quality: grain, weave, finish.
templates.subject: the surface of {product}
templates.action: shows its fine texture as light rakes across
templates.lens: macro lens, shallow depth of field

templates.title: Size in the hand
templates.use: Answer how big it is.
templates.subject: a hand
templates.action: holds {product} up and turns it slowly

templates.title: Flat lay build
templates.use: A styled spread around the product.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: is placed in the center as props slide in around it

templates.title: Detail to full reveal
templates.use: Start on a detail, land on the whole product.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: is revealed from a close detail to the full shape

templates.title: Shelf of options
templates.use: Show the range: colors, scents, sizes.
templates.subject: a row of {product} in different colors
templates.action: line up on a shelf, each catching light in turn

templates.title: Drop into frame
templates.use: A fast hook for the first second.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: drops into frame and lands with a small bounce

templates.title: What goes in it
templates.use: Food, skincare, handmade goods.
templates.subject: the raw ingredients of {product}
templates.action: are added one by one into a bowl

templates.title: How it is made
templates.use: Handmade and small-batch products.
templates.subject: {person}
templates.action: makes {product} by hand at a workbench

templates.title: Gift moment
templates.use: Holiday and gifting ads.
templates.subject: {product} wrapped with a ribbon
templates.action: comes into focus behind a softly blurred candle

templates.title: Problem, then the fix
templates.use: Show what changes when they use it.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: fixes a small everyday problem in one quick move

templates.title: Out in the world
templates.use: Bottles, bags, outdoor gear.
templates.subject: {person}
templates.action: carries {product} on a walk

templates.title: Mirror surface
templates.use: A sleek look for tech and beauty.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: stands on a glossy black surface with a clean reflection

templates.title: Warm and fresh
templates.use: Food, coffee, candles, baked goods.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: gives off gentle steam that curls upward

templates.title: Closing frame
templates.use: End on the product with room for text.
templates.subject: {product}
templates.action: sits on a table as the camera rises to leave open space above
